name: system_info
description: Get Windows system hardware and performance information: CPU model/cores/usage, total & available RAM, GPU info, disk space, and system uptime. Useful for hardware-aware AI reasoning and local model deployment decisions.

info_type.description: Type of info to query: 'cpu' (CPU details & usage), 'memory' (RAM info), 'gpu' (GPU details), 'disk' (disk space), 'all' (full system overview)

handler.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$t='{{info_type}}'; if($t -eq 'cpu' -or $t -eq 'all' -or -not $t) { $cpu=Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name,NumberOfCores,NumberOfLogicalProcessors,MaxClockSpeed,LoadPercentage | Format-List; Write-Output '=== CPU ==='; Write-Output $cpu }; if($t -eq 'memory' -or $t -eq 'all' -or -not $t) { $os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $total=[math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,1); $free=[math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,1); $used=[math]::Round(($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize-$os.FreePhysicalMemory)/1MB,1); Write-Output ''; Write-Output '=== RAM ==='; Write-Output \"Total: $total GB\"; Write-Output \"Used: $used GB\"; Write-Output \"Free: $free GB\"; Write-Output \"Usage: $([math]::Round(($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize-$os.FreePhysicalMemory)*100/$os.TotalVisibleMemorySize,1))%\" }; if($t -eq 'gpu' -or $t -eq 'all' -or -not $t) { try { $gpu=Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name,AdapterRAM,DriverVersion,CurrentHorizontalResolution,CurrentVerticalResolution,CurrentRefreshRate | Format-List; Write-Output ''; Write-Output '=== GPU ==='; Write-Output $gpu } catch {} }; if($t -eq 'disk' -or $t -eq 'all' -or -not $t) { $disk=Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter \"DriveType=3\" | Select-Object DeviceID,@{N='TotalGB';E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,1)}},@{N='FreeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.FreeSpace/1GB,1)}},@{N='UsedPercent';E={[math]::Round(($_.Size-$_.FreeSpace)*100/$_.Size,1)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output ''; Write-Output '=== DISK ==='; Write-Output $disk }; Write-Output ''; Write-Output \"Query time: $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')\" "
